evidence_quotes.O: Since it's been over a year, I decided to do some more research to see if SanDisk offered anything new.
evidence_quotes.C: I'm in IT, so I like being prepared so I have dozens of micro USB chargers & USB cables laying everywhere at work, home, and in my car.
evidence_quotes.E: So my lovely wife bought me a Samsung Galaxy Tab 4 for Father's Day and I've been loving it ever since.
evidence_quotes.A: Not to say external closures are bad... as they do have place in the computing industry but in my scenario, they aren't for me.
evidence_quotes.N: But if there's one thing about a computer component that gets on my nerves the most, it's the fans.
